# Tuskira Corporate Contributor License Agreement

This agreement is adapted from the Apache Software Foundation's ICLA
(Individual Contributor License Agreement) and CCLA (Corporate Contributor
License Agreement), with Tuskira, Inc. in place of the Foundation and an
explicit right for Tuskira to sublicense and relicense Contributions. It is
not affiliated with or endorsed by the Apache Software Foundation.

This version of the agreement lets a company (the "Corporation") authorize
Contributions submitted by its designated employees to this project, and
grant copyright and patent licenses for those Contributions, so that
individual employees do not each need to separately resolve what rights
their employer holds in their work. This agreement is for the
Corporation's protection as a contributor as well as the protection of
Tuskira, Inc. ("Tuskira", "We", or "Us") and the project's users. It does
not change the Corporation's rights to use its own Contributions for any
other purpose.

**How to sign.** A person authorized to bind the Corporation fills in this
document (Corporation name and address, point of contact, and the initial
Schedule A list of authorized employees below), signs it, and emails it to
the contact address in [NOTICE](../../NOTICE) /
[TRADEMARKS.md](../../TRADEMARKS.md). Once on file, each employee named on
Schedule A can sign pull requests individually through the CLA Assistant
bot (see [INDIVIDUAL_CLA.md](INDIVIDUAL_CLA.md) for how an individual
signs); their signature is understood to be made on the Corporation's
behalf under this agreement, not as a personal grant.

**Keeping Schedule A current.** It is the Corporation's responsibility to
notify Tuskira, at the same contact address, whenever the list of
employees authorized to submit Contributions on the Corporation's behalf
changes — adding someone before their first pull request, and removing
someone who leaves or changes roles. Authorization is not tied to any
particular Contribution; it applies to all Contributions an authorized
employee submits while listed.

You (the Corporation, acting through its authorized signatory) accept and
agree to the following terms and conditions for Your present and future
Contributions submitted to Tuskira. Except for the license granted herein
to Tuskira and recipients of software distributed by Tuskira, You reserve
all right, title, and interest in and to Your Contributions — this is a
license, not an assignment of ownership.

## 1. Definitions

"You" (or "Your") means the Corporation identified below, together with
all other entities that control, are controlled by, or are under common
control with the Corporation. "Control" means (i) the power, direct or
indirect, to cause the direction or management of such entity, whether by
contract or otherwise, (ii) ownership of fifty percent (50%) or more of
the outstanding shares, or (iii) beneficial ownership of such entity.

"Contribution" means any original work of authorship, including any
modification or addition to an existing work, that is intentionally
submitted on Your behalf by an employee listed on Schedule A to Tuskira
for inclusion in, or documentation of, any of the products owned or
managed by Tuskira (the "Work"), including this repository. "Submitted"
means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication sent to
Tuskira or its representatives, including but not limited to
communication on mailing lists, source code control systems, and issue
tracking systems managed by or on behalf of Tuskira for the purpose of
discussing and improving the Work — but excluding communication that is
conspicuously marked, or otherwise designated in writing, as "Not a
Contribution."

## 2. Grant of Copyright License

Subject to the terms and conditions of this agreement, You hereby grant to
Tuskira and to recipients of software distributed by Tuskira a perpetual,
worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright
license to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display,
publicly perform, **sublicense**, and distribute Your Contributions and
such derivative works, **including under different license terms than this
project's current open-source license** (for example, a commercial or
otherwise proprietary license, as part of a hosted or paid offering, or
under a different open-source license).

This last point is what lets Tuskira keep offering the project under its
current open-source license while also being able to offer paid or
differently-licensed editions later, without having to go back and ask
every past contributor individually.

## 3. Grant of Patent License

Subject to the terms and conditions of this agreement, You hereby grant to
Tuskira and to recipients of software distributed by Tuskira a perpetual,
worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable (except as
stated in this section) patent license to make, have made, use, offer to
sell, sell, import, and otherwise transfer the Work, where such license
applies only to those patent claims licensable by You that are necessarily
infringed by Your Contribution(s) alone or by combination of Your
Contribution(s) with the Work to which such Contribution(s) were
submitted.

If any entity institutes patent litigation against You or any other entity
(including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit) alleging that Your
Contribution, or the Work to which You have contributed, constitutes
direct or contributory patent infringement, then any patent licenses
granted to that entity under this agreement for that Contribution or Work
shall terminate as of the date such litigation is filed.

**In plain words:** the Corporation keeps its patents — it is not handing
them over. It is only giving permission to use the specific patent claims
that its own contribution actually relies on, not its whole patent
portfolio, and only to Tuskira and to everyone who receives the project
(users, customers, forks). The permission is permanent and free, but it
switches off, for that person only, the moment they sue over a patent
claiming the project infringes it.

## 4. Representations

You represent that You are legally entitled to grant the above license.
You represent further that each employee of the Corporation designated on
Schedule A below (or in a subsequent written modification to that
Schedule, sent to the contact address above) is authorized to submit
Contributions on behalf of the Corporation.

You represent that each of Your Contributions is Your original creation
(see Section 7 for submissions on behalf of others). You represent that
Your Contribution submissions include complete details of any third-party
license or other restriction (including, but not limited to, related
patents and trademarks) of which You are aware and which are associated
with any part of Your Contributions.

## 5. No Obligation of Support

You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to
the extent You desire to provide support. You may provide support for
free, for a fee, or not at all. Unless required by applicable law or
agreed to in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an "AS IS" BASIS,
WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied,
including, without limitation, any warranties or conditions of TITLE,
NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 6. Submitting Third-Party Work

Should You wish to submit work that is not Your original creation, You may
submit it to Tuskira separately from any Contribution, identifying the
complete details of its source and of any license or other restriction
(including, but not limited to, related patents, trademarks, and license
agreements) of which You are aware, and conspicuously marking the work as
"Submitted on behalf of a third party: [named here]".

## 7. Duty to Notify

It is Your responsibility to notify Tuskira, at the contact address above,
of any change required to the list of designated employees authorized to
submit Contributions on behalf of the Corporation, to the Corporation's
point of contact with Tuskira, or to any other fact or circumstance that
would make the representations in this agreement inaccurate in any
respect.

## 8. Your Contributions Stay Open Source

Nothing in this agreement changes the license under which this project is
distributed to the public. Your Contributions are, and remain, available
to everyone under the project's current open-source license (see
[LICENSE](../../LICENSE) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
This agreement only adds rights that Tuskira, specifically, also holds —
it does not take anything away from the rights every other recipient of
the project already has under that open-source license.
